headline: President Bush creates a commission to study mental health care in the United States.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up the President's New Freedom Commission on Mental Health. A commission like this usually studies a topic and gives advice or recommendations to the President. No summary was provided, so details about the commission's members, tasks, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People with mental illness and their families
who_it_affects.how: The commission's focus is mental health, so its findings could shape future federal policy on mental health services.
Providers may be studied or consulted as part of the commission's review of mental health care.
